messages:
ella_sales: Heads-up: EraBank procurement asked for an assurance bundle for their POC. They want SOC 2 Type II evidence, an ISO 27001 snapshot, and a signed pen-test attestation they can retain. Also asking for a note on regional data residency for EU reviewers. Need by COB Friday.

sam_se: We can assemble that. Available artifacts: redacted SOC2 report (2024), ISO27001 cert image, and a pen-test executive summary from BlueWave Security. They explicitly said they do NOT want raw vulnerability details — only an attestation + remediation summary.

ravi_compliance: I can put together a POC packet and draft a one-page attestation letter. Need to confirm: 1) Do they require explicit engagement dates for the pen-test? 2) What exact residency wording do they want (data at rest only, logs, or model hosting)? Legal will need to sign. I can have a draft in ~18 hours.

nora_engineering: For residency language, propose: `For Private deployments, customer data and keys reside in the customer's chosen region; Redwood does not replicate customer data outside the selected region unless explicitly configured.` Also include a KMS line: `Customer-managed keys remain in the customer's VPC and are not exported by Redwood.` I'll attach a Private deployment SVG showing region boundary.

felix_legal: Legal note: Attestation should avoid admitting specific remediation timelines beyond "no unresolved critical findings". We prefer: "No unresolved critical findings remain open as of [date]; a remediation summary is provided." If customer requests the full report, require an executed NDA and handle redaction.

ravi_compliance: Draft attestation language: 
[Date]
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference confirms that an independent penetration test (BlueWave Security) covering the Redwood inference control plane and associated hosting components was conducted on [engagement dates]. No unresolved critical findings remain open as of [remediation date]. The full report is restricted; this attestation and the attached remediation summary are provided for vendor assurance and POC review.
Sincerely,
Redwood Inference 1 Compliance

evidencebot: Evidence ticket created: EVID-4781 assigned to ravi_compliance. Due 1944519999.

ella_sales: Also procurement asked for a single-sentence pricing note comparing Dedicated vs hosted for POC. Keep it high-level.

sam_se: Suggested pricing blurb: "Dedicated trial pricing available for POCs; contact your Redwood rep for short-term commit options and pricing details."

ravi_compliance: Packet contents I'll stage: 1) SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf, 2) ISO27001_cert.jpg, 3) Attestation_draft.pdf (pending Legal signature), 4) Remediation_summary.pdf, 5) Private_deployment_region.svg, 6) Pricing_note.txt, 7) Residency_and_kms_line.txt, 8) Telemetry_statement.txt.

nora_engineering: Telemetry suggestion: `Only aggregated telemetry is collected for performance and capacity planning; customer inputs are not used to train models.`

ravi_compliance: Good, adding that. I'll upload to secure presign and share a short-lived link for EraBank reviewers (internal only).

felix_legal: Once the draft is ready tag Legal Review channel. If they request the full BlueWave report, we'll require NDA + redaction. Approving the attestation as drafted is fine.

ravi_compliance: Uploaded presigned ZIP (expires 7 days): https://internal-s3.redwood.net/presign/EVID-4781/erabank-poc-assurance.zip?exp=7d (do not share publicly).

ella_sales: I'll send the presigned link to EraBank procurement and confirm whether they need Legal countersign prior to download. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
